trades.displayTradeName: Electronic Discharge Machine (EDM) - Wire and Sinker Programmer/Operator
trades.description: An Electronic Discharge Machine EDM Wire and Sinker Programmer/Operator sets up, programs, and runs EDM machines that cut metal with electrical sparks. They load metal parts, choose wire or sinker tools, enter job settings, check measurements, and inspect finished pieces. Their work makes precise molds, dies, and parts that keep tools, machines, and products working properly.
